QUICK CONTEXT: Equal Weight Challenges Mega-Cap Dominance

RSP’s milestone comes as market leadership has become increasingly concentrated among a handful of mega-cap companies. Equal-weight strategies offer investors a way to spread exposure more evenly across companies and sectors rather than allowing the largest stocks to dominate portfolio returns.

That distinction can matter when market leadership broadens. RSP effectively reduces the influence of the largest S&P 500 constituents while increasing the relative weight of smaller index constituents.

The growth of RSPA and the launch of QEW also show how asset managers are extending the equal-weight concept beyond a single flagship fund. Invesco is combining the approach with income generation and Nasdaq-100 exposure, giving investors additional ways to move away from traditional market-cap weighting.
